note: Bangladesh's largest card issuers are private banks (City Bank, BRAC Bank, Eastern Bank among them); their current card schedules weren't found in this pass (BRAC Bank's found were from 2019 and 2023), so Bank Asia, whose schedule this file has held since 2026-10-29, is written alone. Bank Asia's credit card fees and charges (effective 1 March 2026, the file dated 14 July 2026, read again 2026-10-30): the primary card's annual fee by tier, 1,500 taka (Silver / Classic), 2,500 (Gold), 4,000 (Platinum / Titanium), 7,000 (Signature), 15,000 (World Elite), now written before the 15% VAT the schedule applies to all fees and charges, which is written as a tax on fees (until now this file wrote the Silver / Classic fee as 1,725 with the VAT folded in); interest 25% a year; a local cash advance 2.0% or 150 taka, whichever is higher; a late payment and a balance over the limit each 500, 700, 800, 1,000 or 1,200 taka by tier; spending in another currency a 3% markup. The 300-taka SMS alert fee (its period not stated), the US dollar international card fees and the Islamic card's maintenance fees aren't written. Excise duty is 'as per Govt. Policy', without a figure. No minimum payment or grace period is stated.
